notes.title: SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada - Season 2 is live now!
notes.content:
[h2]Drifters, get ready for your next sortie in Season 2, [b]PUNISHING LAND[/b]![/h2]

[h3]Explore two new zones in East Amasia and earn exciting riches with new CRADLECOFFIN, weapons, and new LEGENDARY variants of both![/h3]

[previewyoutube=d7X_oMjD0Pg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This second season is coming out after [b]many adjustments and patches [/b]have been made to the game through its first season. Weapons and Cradle are no longer faction limited, giving players more flexibility in their playstyle. Also, earnings when selling AO Crystals have been increased and the time required to craft Cradles has been reduced to provide a more fluid experience.

Dive into the newly added [b]East Amasia locations[/b] and get your hands on the new Season 2 CRADLECOFFINs and weapons! Amasia Eastern Region has now entered its rainy season, boosting AO Crystals, drop items and Enders to their high tier level, and allowing Drifters to craft “Legendary” weapons and Cradles. Don’t miss on the opportunity to team up with the new[b] Magus Lynn[/b], or [b]Ciel[/b]![/h3]

[h3]Learn more [url=https://bnent.eu/SYN_S2_PatchNote]HERE[/url][/h3]

[h2]Season 2 of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada is live now![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245480/SYNDUALITY_Echo_of_Ada/

notes.title: SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada - Producer Message
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Drifters!
This is Futami, producer of [b]SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada[/b]. Thank you as always for your support on this title. [/h3]

[h3]In Season 2, "Punishing Land," we have incorporated various new elements and improvements so players can enjoy the world of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada with more flexibility and depth – and newcomers have a smoother early game experience. [/h3]

[previewyoutube=XObh4PkF28w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Fixes/Adjustments Overview[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapon/Cradle Adjustments
[*] Easier Requests and Increased Rewards to Improve Early Game Difficulty
[*] Fixes to Matching Rates, Bug Fixes for Specific Operations, and Other Minor Bug Fixes
[/list]
[i]For more details, please check the patch notes [url=https://bnent.eu/SYN-RapidPatch-6]here[/url]
[/i] 
[h3][b]Season 2 Content[/b][/h3]
In Season 2, the new stage "Punishing Land" will be the setting for adventures unlike anything you've encountered. 
In addition to what has already been mentioned, we will be implementing new requests that lead to new areas, events, new rarity weapons and Cradles, Magus, new areas and maps, PvE end-game contents, and many other new elements that will change the way you play.

[h3][b]New Maps/Areas[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Underground Factory:[/b] A complex industrial map with high-tier items guarded by powerful Enders.
[*] [b]Dream Island: [/b]A map of city ruins above toxic water, where falling means failure. High-tier items are placed here, but players need to watch their step and look out for enemy attacks. It’s a high-risk, high-reward area, and a long way down…
[*] [b]Amasia Eastern Region (Rainy Season):[/b] The Amasia Eastern Region has entered the rainy season, upgrading AO crystals, drop items, and Enders all to the high tier level. Take advantage of Cradles that become stronger in the rain and collect materials to craft the "Legendary" weapons and Cradles that will appear in S2.
[/list]
[h3][b]S2 Mid-Season Update[/b][/h3]
[b]Molten Dunes[/b]: A new PvE-only area will be implemented! A raid event will occur where a giant Ender called the "Chaser Empress" occasionally appears, and players can participate regardless of organization. This area's intense heat wave reduces your weather resistance, but you can strategically utilize weapons and Cradles that gain power as your weather resistance falls to overcome this boss.
 
The entire development team will continue to strive to deliver the best possible game experience to all of you and looks forward to more feedback in the future. 
Thank you for your continued support of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada, and we’ll see you in the next Sortie!


[h3]Learn more about what's to come directly from Futami-san [url=https://bnent.eu/SYN_Producers_Message]HERE[/url][/h3]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245480/SYNDUALITY_Echo_of_Ada/

[h3]① Players affected by an issue where their garage level resets after remodeling will also be compensated in the following ways: [/h3]

[*] Any SYNCOINS used for the affected upgrades will be returned

[list]
[*] The amount collected from players who intentionally repeated the above actions will be reduced by a maximum of -99,000,000.
[*] All players who have played before the end of January maintenance will receive 200,000.[/list]
 
[h3]We look forward to your endeavor in East Amasia![/h3]

notes.title: Adjustments and Update for Season 1
notes.content:
Hi Drifters, first of all, thank you to all the Association Members and Bounty Targets who have joined us in the world of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada!

We are actively investigating and verifying reports of issues that some users may be experiencing since the servers have gone live. Please bear with us during this investigation so we can provide users with up to date information.

We have started addressing the value of in-game rewards, materials, and crafts, and will periodically adjust these rewards in a way that ensures a fun and progressive experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879328/6777f2220fd93525154cb01866531f455479b81d.jpg[/img]

[b]Upcoming Season 1 Update:[/b]
We will Introduce a new East Amasia Map, a massive new map that combines the Northern and Southern Zones for experienced Drifters! It won't be unlocked immediately; you'll need to progress your Requests to access it.

[b]Future Plans:[/b]
We will adjust the price for certain CRADLECOFFIN parts to make it easier for new players to access lower rarity CRADLECOFFIN in a future update. Based on player data and feedback, an AO Crystal price adjustment has been done.

We hope for your continued support of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada. Please look forward to more news and updates!

notes.title: Closed Network Test is live!
notes.content:
[h2]Welcome to the Closed Network Test for [b]SYNDUALITY: Echo of Ada[/b], a PvPvE Sci-Fi Extraction Shooter, in which players, accompanied by an AI partner, must survive against xenomorphic creatures and other players, in the hunt for resources.[/h2]

[h3]The servers are live until [u][b]Monday September 16th, 9AM CEST[/b][/u]!

Maintenance is expected on Sunday [u][b]September 15th between 12AM and 4AM CEST[/b][/u].[/h3]

[h2][url=https://en.bandainamcoent.eu/synduality/news/synduality-echo-of-ada-closed-network-test-guide]Check out our CNT Guide here[/url].[/h2]

[h3]Here are some key changes which happened since CBT:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Magus Assistants:[/b] The CNT now features four Magus assistants, each with unique abilities and customization options.
[*] [b]Gameplay Enhancements:[/b] Improved online play for smoother experiences, along with modifications to maps and weapons.
[*] [b]Combat and Balance Adjustments:[/b] Enhanced combat abilities and balance changes to ensure a more engaging and fairer gameplay.
[*] [b]Customization Options:[/b] More parts available for CRADLECOFFIN customization, allowing for greater personalization of your mecha.[/list]

[h3]Get started :[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Magus Creation:[/b] Customize your AI partner’s appearance and abilities to match your playstyle. Choose from two body types and four systems, each offering different perks and drawbacks.
[*] [b]Base Operations:[/b] Upgrade and craft equipment, customize Magus outfits, and take on requests to earn rewards.
[*] [b]Field Basics:[/b] Pilot your CRADLECOFFIN to collect resources, fight hostile Enders, and compete against other players.[/list]

[h3]Additional information:[/h3]
[list][*] Closed Network Test schedule dates and times are [b]subject to change without notice[/b].
[*] This test is a [b]beta version[/b] and may differ from the final product. 
[*] Gameplay data will [b]not transfer to the full game[/b]. 
[*] Closed Network Test can undergo [b]emergency maintenance without notice[/b].[/list]

[h3]Join us in this exclusive opportunity to experience the enhanced world of [b]SYNDUALITY: Echo of Ada[/b] and provide valuable feedback to shape the future of the game![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245480/SYNDUALITY_Echo_of_Ada/
